watch.summary: The creator claims he is a decent driver before immediately crashing and ruining his time trial run.

beats.what: Creator tells chat he is not a bad driver.
The driving race starts as creator mutters 'Oh my goodness'.
Creator crashes into roadside obstacles and flies airborne.
Creator realizes the run is ruined and yells 'I ruined it!'
Creator laughs out loud seeing his final time of 21 seconds.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The instant contrast between his boastful reassurance and immediate disastrous driving creates an effortless comedic payoff. His infectious burst of laughter at his own failure keeps the clip lighthearted.
